scripts.title: Axon Hub | Auto Steal, Auto Break, Auto Merge & Kaitun
scripts.features:
Axon Hub for Break & Steal an Egg combines Auto Steal, Auto Break Eggs, Auto Merge, Auto Hatch, and Egg ESP. Target the pets you want, automate your plot, upgrade your equipment, and manage your collection from one customizable menu.

AUTO STEAL & PET FARM

- Auto Steal — repeatedly find matching pets, collect them, and bring them home.
- Multiple Sources — target loose pets, eggs mid-hatch, eggs other players are breaking, or eggs you break yourself.
- Rarity Filters — choose which rarities are worth collecting.
- Weight Filter — target pets above your selected minimum weight.
- Specific Pet Targeting — select the species you want.
- Zone Selection — choose farming zones or let the script select suitable ones.
- Follow Active Farmers — position near areas where players are breaking eggs.
- Adjustable collection timing, banking delays, and notifications.
- Manual Get One Pet and Bank Carried Pet actions.

AUTO BREAK, MERGE & HATCH

- Auto Break Eggs — approach eligible eggs and break them one at a time.
- Skip Slow Eggs — avoid eggs that exceed your selected estimated breaking time.
- Auto Merge — combine three pets of the same species into a heavier egg.
- Merge Goals — prioritize income, free inventory slots, or combine matching variants.
- Income Protection — optionally reject merges calculated to reduce total income.
- Protect selected rarities, heavy pets, variants, mutated pets, and plotted pets from merging.
- Auto Place Eggs — place merged eggs on your plot.
- Auto Hatch — open growing eggs when they are ready.
- Customize merge intervals and the maximum number of growing eggs.

EGG ESP

- Display possible pets, their rarities, base hatch chances, and projected weights.
- Show egg distance and luck information.
- Filter listed pets by minimum rarity.
- Adjust display range and the maximum number of egg panels.
- Shows possible outcomes—not a guaranteed prediction of the species inside.

BASE & MONEY MANAGEMENT

- Auto Place Pets — fill available plot spaces with stronger pets first.
- Auto Equip Best — update your plot with your best available pets.
- Auto Upgrade Plot and Treadmill using available cash.
- Set upgrade limits and cash reserves.
- Auto Train Speed — use your treadmill while idle.
- Auto Sell Weak Pets with value filters and a protected best-pet count.
- Preview eligible pets before selling.
- View potential pet and egg income directly in your backpack.

SHOPS, EVENTS & REWARDS

- Auto Buy Pickaxe Upgrades with spending reserves and tier limits.
- Auto Buy Trail Upgrades and keep your best owned trail equipped.
- Auto Buy Demon Eggs using available event tokens.
- Maintain selected event potions while the event is active.
- Auto Join Hell Event.
- Auto Claim eligible Index rewards and earned bat tiers.
- Manual reward and offline-earnings claim tools.

NOTIFICATIONS & PERFORMANCE

- Discord webhook pet alerts filtered by rarity, weight, or income.
- Optional mentions, pet images, and server details.
- Anti-AFK, configurable FPS cap, and graphics-reduction options.
- Save and automatically load your preferred configuration.

scripts.title: Ride an Egg by Project UAI
scripts.features:
-- Ride A Pet: full egg pipeline, updated for the Nests update (Oct 2026).
--   COLLECT = stand at a config's Position under ServerData.ActiveEggs and
--             EggPickup:FireServer(<config name>).
--   DROP    = BasketDrop:FireServer() at my plot (bank / satchel).
--   HATCH   = Hatch:FireServer({ EggKey = <egg's EggKey attr> }).
--   PLANT   = hold (equip) a Backpack Tool tagged "Egg", then
--             EggPlaced:FireServer({ NestId = <nest name> }) on one of my
--             plot's Nests (Unlocked=true, not Occupied).
--   UNLOCK  = Remotes.Game.Plot.Nests:FireServer(<nest number>) - costs cash.
-- Growth is weight aware: GameData.General.GrowthTimeFor(GrowthTime, Weight)
-- and DayNight.GrowthElapsed (night grows 10x). Skip Growth is never fired
-- (it costs Robux). Runs off a single Heartbeat loop.
